title: Is Merging Worth It? Securely Evaluating the Information Gain for Causal Dataset Acquisition
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and mathematical frameworks for causal dataset acquisition and privacy-preserving computation (Secure Multi-Party Computation and Differential Privacy). While it briefly mentions that merging datasets in sensitive domains like healthcare can involve lengthy 'ethical approval procedures', it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
